subject.title: [Feature]: Move away from useMultiFileAuthState for Baileys

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin make a plugin-owned SQLite authentication schema canonical for credentials and Signal keys, with a one-time verified doctor migration that removes the Baileys JSON runtime path?
rationale: This changes the persistence and recovery boundary for session-hijacking credentials and cryptographic keys, requiring explicit decisions about permissions, transactions, backups, migration failure, and secure cleanup.

options.title: Approve SQLite Migration
options.body: Use a plugin-owned Kysely schema, migrate and verify every account before cleanup, and retain no steady-state file fallback.

options.title: Continue File Hardening
options.body: Keep improving the multi-file path while accepting that it does not resolve the requested production storage architecture.

options.title: Require Re-pairing
options.body: Use the database only for new pairings and require existing users to re-pair, explicitly accepting upgrade disruption instead of migrating keys.

recommendation.title: Approve SQLite Migration
recommendation.body: Use a plugin-owned Kysely schema, migrate and verify every account before cleanup, and retain no steady-state file fallback.
